s: What was the total crew strength (officers, petty officers, sailors) aboard the French aircraft carrier Charles De Gaulle during the Indo-French naval exercise ' Varuna-2004 ' in April 2004?
x: Charles De Gaulle's complement is about 1,350 ship's company plus about 600 in the air wing – roughly 1,950 in all, the figure reported for Varuna-2004 (April 2004). 2,000 is only a rounded figure, and 156 and 105 are far too small for a nuclear-powered carrier.

s: As part of Green initiative, Indian Navy installed solar power panels on board on?
x: INS Sarvekshak, a hydrographic survey ship of the Southern Naval Command, was the first Indian Navy ship to install a solar power system under the Navy's Green Initiative (February 2017): 18 flexible 300-W panels, about 5.4 kW. Vikramaditya (carrier), Virat (decommissioned carrier) and Kalvari (submarine) were not part of this project.
